objective: Explain the main advantages and risks of multi-agent AI systems compared to single powerful models.
plan:
**Coordinator’s Plan: “Advantages & Risks of Multi‑Agent AI vs. Single‑Powerful Models”** | Step | Objective | Specialist | Deliverable | Timeframe | |------|-----------|------------|-------------|-----------| | 1 | **Define Scope & Key Dimensions** | **Subject‑Matter Expert (SME)** – AI & Systems | • List of dimensions (e.g., scalability, robustness, interpretability, cost, coordination overhead)
• Clear definition of “multi‑agent” vs. “single‑powerful” | 0.5 h | | 2 | **Literature & Data Mining** | **Researcher** | • Annotated bibliography of peer‑reviewed papers, industry reports, and case studies (last 5 yrs)
• Dataset of real‑world deployments (e.g., autonomous driving, finance, healthcare) | 1 h | | 3 | **Benefit Analysis** | **Analyst** | • Quantitative & qualitative assessment of each advantage (e.g., fault tolerance, parallelism, specialization)
• Illustrative examples & metrics | 1 h | | 4 | **Risk Analysis** | **Analyst** | • Identification of risks (coordination complexity, security, emergent behavior, resource contention)
• Risk‑impact matrix | 1 h | | 5 | **Synthesis & Drafting** | **Writer** | • Structured draft: Introduction, Advantages, Risks, Comparative Summary, Recommendations | 1 h | | 6 | **Peer Review & Feedback** | **Editor** | • Consolidated feedback notes
• Revised draft incorporating comments | 0.5 h | | 7 | **Final Summary & Visuals** | **Designer** (optional) | • Executive summary table
• Infographic or slide deck (if needed) | 0.5 h | | 8 | **Quality Assurance & Sign‑off** | **Coordinator** | • Final checklist: completeness, clarity, citations, formatting | 0.25 h | --- ### Workflow & Communication 1. **Kick‑off** – Coordinator briefs all specialists on objectives, deliverables, and deadlines. 2. **Daily Stand‑up** – 10‑minute sync (via chat) to track progress, blockers, and next actions. 3. **Central Repository** – All documents stored in a shared folder (Google Drive / Confluence). 4. **Version Control** – Use Git or equivalent for drafts to track changes. 5. **Final Review** – Coordinator reviews the final draft, ensures alignment with the objective, and signs off. --- ### Success Metrics | Metric | Target | |--------|--------| | Completion Time | ≤ 5 h from kickoff | | Quality | ≥ 90 % clarity & accuracy (peer‑review score) | | Deliverables | All steps completed, final summary + visuals ready for distribution | --- **Next Action (by Coordinator):** - Assign SME to Step 1 and Researcher to Step 2. - Set up shared workspace and schedule the first stand‑up. Feel free to adjust timelines or add specialists (e.g., Data Scientist) if deeper technical analysis is required.
